```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("cea_helpers", "report_format"),
  set_knitr = FALSE, set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-psa, include=FALSE}
psa_obj <- load_psa_cache(verbose = FALSE)

display_df <- if (!is.null(psa_obj)) {
  create_psa_summary_table(psa_obj, wtp = WTP) %>%
    filter(Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
    mutate(
      Strategy = strategy_labels[Strategy],
      Mean_Cost = format_eur(Mean_Cost),
      Mean_QALY = sprintf("%.2f", Mean_QALY),
      Prob_CE = scales::percent(Prob_CE, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
} else {
  data.frame()
}
```

```{r display-table}
if (nrow(display_df) > 0) {
  kable(
    display_df,
    caption = "Table 5: PSA summary at the base-case willingness-to-pay threshold",
    format = "html",
    col.names = c("Strategy", "Mean Cost", "Mean QALYs", "Probability Cost-Effective"),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    footnote(
      general = paste0("WTP threshold: EUR ", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY."),
      general_title = "Notes: "
    )
} else {
  cat("PSA cache not available. Run scripts/R/analysis/12_PSA.R first.")
}
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(display_df) > 0) {
  tables_dir <- here("tables")
  if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  write.csv(display_df, file = here("tables", "table_5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

Table 5 has been saved to `tables/table_5.csv`.
